rubric.benchmark: Evidence-based internal implementation-readiness assessment, not an external benchmark.

dimensions.label: Conversion clarity
dimensions.afterRationale: The reviewed plugin README now opens with outcomes, proof, three equal host paths, and a direct install path; this independently supports the 46-point gain from the development-first baseline.
dimensions.remainingGap: The dedicated public repository still has no README, while the public product repository continues to open on stale, text-first mock-generation copy.

dimensions.label: Editorial personality
dimensions.afterRationale: The checked-in voice contract and reviewed flagship copy replace default-heavy explanation with concise, producer-minded guidance and a restrained friendly tone.
dimensions.remainingGap: The branch clears the target, but the public product repository's older first-screen voice still needs a separate evidence-led refresh.

dimensions.label: Visual proof and rhythm
dimensions.afterRationale: Fresh product-proof composites, registered provenance, narrow-render checks, and the live 1280×640 plugin social preview support the 52-point improvement without treating editorial art as host proof.
dimensions.remainingGap: The dedicated public repository has no README in which to establish the planned visual rhythm, and the product repository remains generic and text-heavy above the fold.

dimensions.label: GitHub SEO
dimensions.afterRationale: Focused assistant-video copy, canonical entity links, eight relevant public topics, and repository-specific distribution metadata make the intended search entity substantially clearer.
dimensions.remainingGap: The dedicated repository has no indexable README or tagged release, so its strongest query passages are not yet part of the public repository surface.

dimensions.label: Human-facing GEO
dimensions.afterRationale: Five public intent owners, extractable answer passages, host-neutral entity wording, and crawler-readable source declarations support the 26-point gain from the original first-party-only structure.
dimensions.remainingGap: No earned citation or clean post-change observation window yet shows that an external answer engine selects these passages.

dimensions.label: Agent discovery and selection
dimensions.afterRationale: The reviewed 24-case discovery layer and 70-case selection corpus now cover named Claude and Codex discovery, negative routing, citations, safety, and recovery with deterministic policy results.
dimensions.remainingGap: Curated discovery is 100%, but the separately reviewed claude_host and codex_host evidence columns correctly remain null.

dimensions.label: Trust and evidence
dimensions.afterRationale: Proof provenance, paid-action safety gates, public support/security files, and a real 0.2.0 product-repository release establish a reviewable trust chain.
dimensions.remainingGap: The dedicated public repository has no tagged release, checksum, or archived real-host result packet of its own.

dimensions.label: Distribution and backlinks
dimensions.afterRationale: A second focused public repository, owned-site acquisition paths, and ten evidence-gated distribution decisions support the 24-point gain without inventing a directory acceptance or backlink.
dimensions.remainingGap: The plugin repository remains bootstrap-only and no authoritative external listing, contextual referring domain, or approved directory backlink has been verified.

dimensions.label: Measurement and iteration
dimensions.afterRationale: Fail-closed UTM maps, privacy-filtered browser projection, and clean cohort definitions establish implementation readiness without fabricating conversion performance.
dimensions.remainingGap: There is no privacy-reviewed server-side GitHub-to-MCP association, library_opened emitter, complete emitter coverage, or clean 14-day cohort.
